summary: Feed s092_single to NDR is degraded: 100% of packets are untagged and required VLANs 10, 20 are completely missing. All other checks (duplicates, encrypted share, one-way traffic, packet drops, tool overload) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker or SPAN/TAP source is stripping 802.1Q tags - likely broker port configured to strip VLAN headers or traffic sourced from access ports instead of trunk/TAP. Evidence shows 100% untagged packets where VLANs 10 and 20 are required.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR loses VLAN segmentation context for VLANs 10 and 20. Cannot apply VLAN-aware detection policies, correlate assets by segment, or detect lateral movement within those VLANs - creates complete blind spot for required segments despite needing full payload and bidirectional visibility.

recommended_fix.why: NDR profile requires VLANs 10 and 20 for detection coverage. Preserving/passing through 802.1Q tags restores segmentation visibility without affecting other healthy parameters.
